$comment: Moderate advisories with no non-breaking fix, reviewed 2026-11-05 by the agent; the repository owner (Joshua Small) decides whether to keep accepting them. Each must name its scope and expire; scripts/ci/audit-policy.mjs fails on an expired or missing entry, and on any high or critical advisory.

exceptions.scope: Build time only: used to trace files while building the Vercel function. Not in the deployed function bundle and never given visitor input.
exceptions.reason: The only fix is glob 14, which @vercel/nft does not support yet; npm's suggested fix downgrades @astrojs/vercel to 8.x.

exceptions.scope: Build and development time only: patterns come from our own build configuration, never from visitors.
exceptions.reason: Fixed only in minimatch 11, which the depending packages do not accept yet.

exceptions.scope: Development only: drizzle-kit's bundled esbuild dev server, which this project never starts. Not installed in production builds' output.
exceptions.reason: drizzle-kit pins the old esbuild; the fix needs a drizzle-kit release that drops @esbuild-kit.
